sourceChecks.text: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ペリシテ人が神の箱をダゴンの家に置いたと本文に記す。

sourceChecks.text: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 翌朝、ダゴン像が主の箱の前に倒れていたと記す。

sourceChecks.text: When they arose early on the following morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD’s ark; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold. Only Dagon’s torso was intact.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 翌朝、ダゴン像の頭と両手が敷居に落ちていたと記す。

sourceChecks.text: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダゴンの祭司らが敷居を踏まない習慣を説明する。

sourceChecks.text: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アシュドドの人々が「われわれの神ダゴン」と呼ぶ。

wikipediaArticleRead.noteJa: 記事は古代シリアなどで崇拝された神ダゴンを扱い、ヘブライ語聖書がペリシテ人の神として記すことと、サムエル記上5章のアシュドドの神殿の場面を紹介します。
wikipediaArticleRead.verifiedHeadingOrText: 記事の冒頭はDagon/Daganを神として紹介し、§Jewish and Christian scripturesはヘブライ語聖書のペリシテ人の神、アシュドドの神殿と1 Samuel 5:2–7の箱と像の場面を説明。
